title: Chat view with the "show terminal" switch as the agent tab body
summary: Turns every agent tab into a chat view (bubbles, clickable answers, permission buttons, a message box) with a show-terminal switch and the meeting's open channel; chat is the default runtime again. Three review rounds each found a real bug; the last open one is that Use it on a grilling tab sends the held transcript words instead of what the member edited in the box.
friction: No CI and no real-app run: the test browser (happy-dom) missed a hidden attribute overridden by a theme display rule, and a box-versus-held-words mismatch, so each found only by a fresh reviewer — three review rounds and the story ended needs-human
lessons_learned: Chat-view and meeting-channel stories need the dev to launch the app (or a probe test over the real stylesheets) and test every send path against what the message box shows before the first review
